1. Operator and eligibility

These terms are between you and kikitalk’s operator, Li Hao (李浩), an individual developer. Contact: 2114581274@qq.com. Website: https://kiki.group/. Read these terms and the Privacy Policy before actively confirming. You can contact us first with questions.

The service is for adults aged 18 or over only. Confirm your eligibility truthfully. Do not register on behalf of a minor or let a minor use your account. The current product is in iOS testing and provides actual voice chat and related account features. Testing is not a reason to infringe others’ rights without cause or waive the operator’s legal duties.

2. Account and sign-in security

The current version uses only Sign in with Apple and requires you to set a separate nickname on first entry. The former ID sign-in and automatic merging of old test accounts are no longer offered. Use an Apple account you are entitled to use and protect your device and Apple credentials. We identify your sign-in through Apple system authorization and server verification, without requiring your Apple password. Using the same Apple account under the same developer’s app gives access to the corresponding service account, but does not restore a deleted account’s information.

Use lawful nicknames, avatars and profiles that do not impersonate others. Contact the public email promptly if your account is impersonated, your device is lost or you notice unusual use. We will verify and assist, but cannot guarantee restoration of access without verifiable identity credentials. Account deletion and signing out have different consequences; follow the app’s prompts carefully.

3. Voice chat and public content

You can listen, speak and send room text in available rooms. Features depend on your role, device permissions and service status. Rooms offer five preset backgrounds that adapt to the device’s light or dark appearance; hosts choose one when creating or editing a room. Video broadcasting and sound effects are not currently available. Profile information, voice and text you actively publish reach the relevant room members. Do not publish information you do not want public or have no right to disclose. Minimizing to a floating bubble may keep the audio session active. Leave the room or turn off the microphone to stop the relevant communication.

You must have the necessary rights or authorization for content you publish and respect others’ privacy, likeness, copyright and other lawful interests. To provide services to you and the intended recipients, you authorize us to transmit, process, cache and display content you actively submit to the necessary extent. This authorization is limited to the selected service and legal duties; it does not transfer ownership or authorize unrelated advertising.

The community currently provides following, followers, mutual follows, public profiles and text private messages without a mutual-follow requirement. Each sender may send up to five messages before the other person first replies, and continue after a reply. Respect others’ willingness to communicate. Do not send harassment, scams or spam. Unfollowing does not restrict existing communication. A block by either party stops private messaging between them and affects content visibility. Do not evade first-contact limits by clearing history or signing in again. Do not collect profiles or images provided by the service in bulk without authorization. Your own content can be deleted; report evidence and necessary audits are retained under the Privacy Policy. Allowing system notifications enables private-message and interaction alerts, but networks, system settings and Apple services affect delivery and timing. Notifications are not guaranteed to arrive and do not replace content and permission checks in the app. Private message history is retained for up to 30 days; do not use this service as long-term file or chat storage.

Mic-seat relationship displays use fixed versions of BaZi, MBTI community and simplified zodiac rules for room conversation. They do not guarantee actual relationship quality, destiny or event outcomes. Once you agree to the current documents, entered BaZi information participates in server-side calculations, and MBTI and birthday-derived zodiac signs are shared as public labels, without a separate participation confirmation on the profile page. Birth information and Four Pillars are visible only to you; other room members see only permitted relationship results. You can correct or clear details under Me. Unknown birth times are not filled with defaults. Do not probe other people’s private birth information through bulk calculations, impersonated details or similar methods.

4. Conduct and feedback

Do not use the service to distribute unlawful, sexual, violent, fraudulent or rights-infringing content; harass, threaten, discriminate, impersonate or disclose others’ personal information; induce minors to participate; send spam advertising; undermine network or account security; misuse cloud resources; or disrupt rooms. Do not record or publicly distribute others’ voices or images without lawful authorization.

If you find rule violations, infringement or safety issues, use the report options on a room, member or message, or send the room identifier, relevant time and necessary details to 2114581274@qq.com. Provide only evidence needed to handle the issue and avoid spreading others’ sensitive information. We verify and apply measures under our rules, such as warnings, temporary text or microphone restrictions, temporary voice admission restrictions, closing violating rooms, dismissing reports or lifting restrictions. Account sign-in and settings remain available for appeals, withdrawal and account deletion. Voice moderation does not ban your Apple account. We do not currently promise fully automatic voice moderation or round-the-clock human staffing. Appeal through the same email if you disagree with an outcome.

You can block other users and unblock them in Settings. In public rooms, blocking mainly controls your own reception of text and audio; it does not prevent others from receiving your public speech. Hosts’ and room moderators’ in-room authority is separate from platform community moderation authority. A display name or membership status does not give an ordinary user administrative powers.

5. Charges and third-party services

The current version has no top-ups, paid membership or host settlement. Extension capabilities present in interfaces or SDKs do not mean those commercial services have been enabled. If paid features are introduced, prices, benefits, purchasing and refund rules will be explained in advance and necessary confirmation obtained under applicable platform and legal requirements. You bear network data and similar charges according to your agreement with your network provider.

Real-time communication depends on our self-hosted LiveKit nodes and necessary network and Apple identity services. Information handling is described in the Privacy Policy and SDK list. Network, device, system permission or service problems can affect quality. We investigate and respond within a reasonable scope without guaranteeing uninterrupted communication in every environment.

6. Service changes and responsibility

We may adjust test features to maintain security, fix faults or improve the experience. For significant changes affecting your main interests, suspension or termination, we provide advance notice where reasonably practicable and handle information and rights as required by law. You can stop using the service, withdraw authorization or delete your account.

You are responsible for conduct for which you bear legal responsibility. We are legally responsible for our violations of law or these terms. These terms do not exclude or limit liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited, or remove your legal rights to complain, litigate or seek other remedies. Responsibility for effects of force majeure, network issues not caused by the operator or third-party failures is determined by the facts and applicable law.

7. Signing out, withdrawal and account deletion

App settings let you sign out, withdraw privacy consent or request account deletion. Deletion removes the online service account and corresponding deletable data. Section 7 of the Privacy Policy explains deletion scope and the handling boundaries for room records, backups and data in older third-party services. Deletion does not mean all third-party and historical copies are cleared at the same instant. Contact us for further verification or cleanup.

Signing out or withdrawing privacy consent does not automatically delete the service account. Withdrawal stops services requiring that consent and revokes service sessions. To return, you must meet the age requirement, confirm the applicable documents again and authorize through Apple. You can also manage this app’s authorization in Apple system settings. Stopping Apple authorization and deleting the app’s service account have different processing scopes; see the Privacy Policy and app prompts.

8. Updates and disputes

When changes to these terms affect main rights or obligations, we update the version and show an in-app prompt. Changes requiring your renewed confirmation are confirmed before you continue the relevant service. If you disagree, you may stop using the service and handle existing accounts and information in accordance with law.

These terms are governed by the laws of the People’s Republic of China. In a dispute, both parties may first seek agreement through the public email. If that fails, they may seek relief from a people’s court with jurisdiction or another competent institution as provided by law. These terms do not unreasonably restrict consumers’ lawful choice of jurisdiction or other statutory rights.
